Metadata.description: Open-source file browser for S3, R2, and other storage backends. Browse, preview, search, and manage files in a modern, self-hosted web interface.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Manage the app appearance and information.
Settings.appearanceHint: Choose how the interface looks on this device.
Settings.timeFormatHint: Choose how file times are displayed.
Settings.showImagePreviewsHint: Display image contents directly in file thumbnails. This may use additional network data.
Settings.showExtensionsHint: Display extensions like .pdf or .docx in the file browser.
Settings.showHiddenFilesHint: Display dot-prefixed files and folders, such as .env or .well-known, in the file browser.
Settings.directClientRequestsHint: When on, connections you add in the app talk to storage directly from your browser instead of routing through this app's server. Requires the bucket to have CORS configured. WebDAV connections always route through the server.
Settings.appDescription: Open-source file browser for S3, R2, and other storage backends. Browse, preview, search, and manage files in a modern, self-hosted web interface.

Connection.addDescription: Connect S3, R2, WebDAV, and other storage services. Credentials stay in your browser only.
Connection.editDescription: Update this connection and test it before saving.
Connection.name: Name
Connection.nameHint: Shown in the sidebar. Defaults to the bucket name.
Connection.alibabaRegionHint: Alibaba OSS region code, without the “oss-” prefix.
Connection.alibabaEndpointHint: Optional. For cn-hangzhou, defaults to oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com.
Connection.backblazeRegionHint: B2 cluster code shown next to the bucket endpoint.
Connection.backblazeEndpointHint: Optional. For us-west-002, defaults to s3.us-west-002.backblazeb2.com.
Connection.tencentRegionHint: Tencent COS region code, such as ap-guangzhou or ap-shanghai.
Connection.tencentEndpointHint: Optional. For ap-guangzhou, defaults to cos.ap-guangzhou.myqcloud.com.
Connection.minioEndpointHint: Your MinIO server URL, including the scheme.
Connection.publicBaseUrlHint: Optional. A CDN/public origin; when set, file URLs skip signing.
Connection.webdavBaseUrlHint: The WebDAV collection URL, e.g. https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/me. Works with Nextcloud, ownCloud, Apache mod_dav, and most NAS boxes.
Connection.webdavRootHint: Optional. Browse only this folder on the server. Leave empty for the collection root.
Connection.webdavPublicBaseUrlHint: Optional. A public HTTP origin fronting the same files enables direct preview URLs; without it, files are streamed through this app's server.
Connection.errorAccessDenied: Access denied. Check the access key and secret, and that the credentials have permission to list this bucket.
Connection.errorNotFound: Bucket not found. Check the bucket name, and the region or endpoint.
Connection.errorGeneric: Could not connect. Check the bucket, credentials, and region/endpoint.
Connection.webdavErrorConnect: Could not connect to the WebDAV server. Check that the server URL points at a WebDAV collection (e.g. /remote.php/dav/files/you on Nextcloud) and that the username and password are correct.

Explorer.emptyFiltered: No items match the active filters
Explorer.moveAlreadyHere: The items are already in this folder.
Explorer.moveIntoItself: Can’t move a folder into itself.
Explorer.moveNameExists: An item with this name already exists there.
Explorer.moveNameExistsNamed: An item named “{name}” already exists there.

Dialogs.moveDescription: Pick a destination folder, then move here.
Dialogs.deleteItemsDescription: These {count} items will be permanently deleted, including everything inside any folders.
Dialogs.deleteFolderDescription: “{name}” will be permanently deleted along with everything inside it.

Marked.recentsHint: Files you open show up here for quick access.
Marked.starredHint: Star a file from its preview or from this list to keep it handy.

Browser.noBucketDescription: Connect an S3, R2, Alibaba OSS, Tencent COS, Backblaze B2, or S3-compatible bucket to browse its objects. Local credentials stay in your browser; the bucket must allow CORS.

Upload.uploading: Uploading {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}…

Viewer.noPreviewDescription: This file type can’t be previewed. Download it or open it in a new tab.
Viewer.noUrl: Couldn’t resolve a URL for this file.
Viewer.codeTooLarge: File is too large to preview. Download it instead.
